short.en: Energy, added all the way down

t.zh: 一张图只有 1 像素宽。每个像素有一个能量，写在格子左上角：越显眼的像素能量越高。
t.en: A picture just 1 pixel wide. Every pixel has an energy, written in its cell’s top-left corner: the more it stands out, the higher its energy.

t.zh: 一条缝从顶走到底，每行经过一个像素。缝的能量是它经过的像素的能量之和。
t.en: A seam runs from the top to the bottom, through one pixel in each row. A seam’s energy is the total energy of the pixels it passes through.

goal.zh: 这条缝从顶走到底，能量一共是多少？每格存「从顶走到这里的能量」。
goal.en: What is the total energy of the seam from top to bottom? Each cell holds “the energy from the top down to here”.

how.en: Row by row, from the top down.

hints.zh: 到这一格的能量 = 到上一格的能量 + 这一格自己的能量。
hints.en: The energy down to this cell = the energy down to the cell above + this cell’s own.

hints.zh: 顶行上面什么也没有：在顶行送一个 0 进去。
hints.en: Above the top row there is nothing: feed a 0 in on the top row.

body.zh: 一根柱子只有一条缝，表只是把能量一格格加下来。
body.en: A single column has only one seam, and the table just adds the energy down cell by cell.
